title: The Making of the Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Repository

traced_head.message: Close initial World Map quality-audit bugs

commit_style_note: The repository uses an unusually atomic and heavily tool-assisted commit style. Tests, validators, contracts, documentation, implementation, migration and cleanup steps are often committed separately. Commit count therefore measures recorded construction decisions and repository activity, not an ordinary one-feature-per-commit human workflow.

daily_commits_utc.phase: Foundation explosion: canonical Potatoverse, North, chronology, symbols, theology, psychology and initial architecture.
Taxonomy and retrieval: context graphs, provenance, epistemic layers, indexing, search and content classification.
Knowledge engine: canonical body systems, evidence registries, science atlases, attestation sources and synchronized readers.
Interactive knowledge: entity-aware tracing, progressive inspectors, time/evidence state and richer retrieval surfaces.
Formalization: Axis/Door dynamics, vortex/spiral research, dimensions, consciousness and project consolidation.
Great consolidation: salvage of older branches and PRs into canonical architecture, readers, Bible material and World Map foundations.
Culture and contextual readers: tighter public surfaces, lifecycle models and recovered developmental hinges.
Prediction and chronology deepening: North Axis foresight, fulfilled-only audit work, restored diary material and public narrative.
House and reader convergence: Spiral Reader, route authority, conversation recovery, subdivision search and performance budgets.
Evidence Root and integrity: public-statement ownership, Rooms navigation, CI contracts and canonical source cleanup.
Product hardening: TTS behavior, reader edge cases, World Map hover/context and globe rendering fixes.
House population: Foundation/Below grammar, Room status, Door histories, Today snapshots and two-field topology integration.
Convergence and naming: homepage authority, Timeline migration, map-state hardening and validation.
Systems engineering: centralized map ownership, motion policy, ADL/subdivision evidence, Canadian provinces, quality audits and bug closure.

activity_summary.message_category_counts_note: Categories overlap; a commit can match several themes.

repository_shape.interpretation: The repository is structurally more knowledge/data corpus than visual website. Public pages increasingly act as projections over canonical structured owners.

developmental_story.description: The repository begins by materializing an already-developed conceptual world: Potatoverse canon, North Programme, Kingdom Atlas, chronology, economics, symbols, theology and psychology.

developmental_story.phase: 2 — Teach the archive what kind of thing each thing is
developmental_story.description: Taxonomy, provenance, evidence classes and canonical records appear. The project shifts from collecting material toward distinguishing source, attestation, interpretation, canon and later synthesis.
Readers, inspectors, entity-aware traces, time state, science relationships and formal Axis/Door research turn the archive into an interactive knowledge system.

Legacy PRs and branches are salvaged selectively. House authority, public routes, Spiral Reader, canonical owners, World Map performance and conversation recovery begin converging around one architecture.

CI, tests, TTS behavior, accessibility, motion policy, router ownership, typed evidence contracts, subdivision systems and critic-level bug ledgers dominate. The system begins policing its own consistency.

central_transition.to: Forbid raw camera transitions outside Motion owner.
central_transition.meaning: The history moves from naming a worldview to engineering the infrastructure that can hold, retrieve, render, test and revise that worldview.

projected_end_state.description: A living computational library/world rather than a single website: one canonical knowledge corpus projected through History, Timeline, Story, House, Rooms, Paths, Axis, World Map, Science, Religion, Philosophy, Great Book, Evidence and machine-readable discovery surfaces.
core_capabilities: preserve first appearance and developmental history without backdating later interpretations
distinguish canon, testimony, evidence, comparison, interpretation, inference and creative lore
let humans listen/read continuously while optional links open specialist rooms
let machines retrieve canonical owners and provenance rather than scrape duplicated prose
map time, geography, relations, evidence and conceptual topology as different views over one corpus
revise current synthesis without deleting the record of how earlier synthesis arose
